claims: The 2026 Masters Tournament coverage is available on CBS, ESPN, Paramount+, and Prime Video.
2026 Masters Tournament streaming is available on Masters.com and the Masters App.
Round 1 and Round 2 coverage of the 2026 Masters Tournament on April 9-10 airs on ESPN from 3 p.m. to 7:30 p.m. ET.
Round 1 and Round 2 coverage of the 2026 Masters Tournament on April 9-10 airs on Prime Video from 1 p.m. to 3 p.m. ET.
2026 Masters Tournament weekend coverage on April 11-12 features early play on Paramount+ from noon to 2 p.m. ET.
2026 Masters Tournament weekend coverage on April 11-12 features CBS from 2 p.m. to 7 p.m. ET.
All times in the 2026 Masters TV & Streaming Schedule are ET.
Round 1 of the 2026 Masters Tournament is on Thursday, April 9.
Round 2 of the 2026 Masters Tournament is on Friday, April 10.
Round 3 of the 2026 Masters Tournament is on Saturday, April 11.
Final Round of the 2026 Masters Tournament is on Sunday, April 12.
Golf Channel (Live From The Masters) covers Round 1 of the 2026 Masters Tournament from 8 a.m. to 3 p.m. ET on Thursday, April 9.
Amazon Prime Video covers Round 1 of the 2026 Masters Tournament from 1 p.m. to 3 p.m. ET on Thursday, April 9.
ESPN/ESPN App covers Round 1 of the 2026 Masters Tournament from 3 p.m. to 7:30 p.m. ET on Thursday, April 9.
Masters.com & Masters App covers Round 1 of the 2026 Masters Tournament from 1 p.m. to 7:30 p.m. ET on Thursday, April 9.
Golf Channel (Live From The Masters) covers Round 2 of the 2026 Masters Tournament from 8 a.m. to 3 p.m. ET on Friday, April 10.
Amazon Prime Video covers Round 2 of the 2026 Masters Tournament from 1 p.m. to 3 p.m. ET on Friday, April 10.
ESPN/ESPN App covers Round 2 of the 2026 Masters Tournament from 3 p.m. to 7:30 p.m. ET on Friday, April 10.
Masters.com & Masters App covers Round 2 of the 2026 Masters Tournament from 1 p.m. to 7:30 p.m. ET on Friday, April 10.
Paramount+ covers Round 3 of the 2026 Masters Tournament from 12 p.m. to 2 p.m. ET on Saturday, April 11.
CBS & Paramount+ covers Round 3 of the 2026 Masters Tournament from 2 p.m. to 7 p.m. ET on Saturday, April 11.
Golf Channel (Live From The Masters) covers Round 3 of the 2026 Masters Tournament from 7 p.m. to 9 p.m. ET on Saturday, April 11.
Paramount+ covers the final round of the 2026 Masters Tournament from 12 p.m. to 2 p.m. ET on Sunday, April 12.
CBS & Paramount+ covers the final round of the 2026 Masters Tournament from 2 p.m. to 7 p.m. ET on Sunday, April 12.
Golf Channel (Live From The Masters) covers the final round of the 2026 Masters Tournament from 7 p.m. to 9 p.m. ET on Sunday, April 12.
Masters.com and Masters App provide Featured Groups coverage daily for the 2026 Masters Tournament beginning around 10:15 a.m. ET.
Masters.com and Masters App provide live streaming of Amen Corner (holes 11, 12, and 13) for the 2026 Masters Tournament starting at 11:45 a.m. ET.
Masters.com and Masters App provide Featured Holes coverage of holes 4, 5, and 6 for the 2026 Masters Tournament at 10:30 a.m. ET.
Masters.com and Masters App provide Featured Holes coverage of holes 15 and 16 for the 2026 Masters Tournament at 12:30 p.m. ET.
"Mornings at the Masters" show airs at 9 a.m. ET on YouTube.
"On the Range" airs at 10 a.m. ET on Masters.com.
